title: Orchestrate lane profile, version 1
description: Which lane, model, and reasoning tier each life-cycle stage runs on, keyed by the orchestrating runtime's own exposed label. The package ships no profile: this document only says what a user-written one may contain.

decision_policy.description: The run's standing decision policy: who answers when a stage would need the human. Top-level, not per runtime, because it is about the human and not the machine. Absent means 'attended'. A policy named in the request overrides this.

yolo.description: The one value a yolo run cannot derive for itself. Nothing else about yolo is configurable: it is a policy, not a menu.

human_reviewer.description: The login to request as human reviewer when neither the ticket nor project conventions name one. Routing data like github_login: a login to request, never an identity to claim.

runtimes.description: Keyed by an arbitrary runtime key. The reserved key 'default' applies when no entry's match list matches this runtime's label.

match.description: Case-insensitive substrings of the label the runtime exposes about itself.

cli.description: Other runtimes this machine can launch non-interactively, keyed by the name a 'cli:NAME' lane refers to.

command.description: The executable and its arguments. {model}, {effort}, and {cwd} are substituted at launch; an unfilled placeholder is dropped together with its preceding flag.

stage.description: A stage's lane and, where its runtime accepts them, its model and reasoning tier. There is no key for how a monitoring stage is invoked: under orchestration no stage attaches a watcher of its own, and each is invoked one wake-up pass at a time.
